result.paraphrase: ADATA XPG SX6000 Pro 256GB SSD, PCIe Gen3x4 M.2 2280 (R:2100/W:1200 MB/s). This SSD helps you boot, load, and transfer faster. Built with 3D NAND Flash and NVMe 1.3 support, the SX6000 Pro delivers up to 4x the speed of SATA SSDs and comes in capacities up to 1TB. Its single-sided, slimmer-than-standard M.2 2280 design improves compatibility. Features include PCIe Gen3x4, LDPC ECC for better data integrity, and a cool XPG heatsink, plus a 5-year warranty. TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS: Capacity 256GB; Form Factor M.2 2280; NAND Flash 3D TLC; Dimensions (L x W x H) 22 x 80 x 3.5mm; Weight 8g; Interface PCIe Gen3x4; Consumption 0.33W Active (Typical); Controller Realtek; 0.14W Idle (Typical) (*measured by power meter); Operating Temperature 0°C~70°C; Storage Temperature -40°C~85°C; Shock Resistance 1500G/0.5ms; MTBF 2,000,000 hours; Certifications RoHS, CE, FCC, BSMI, VCCI, KC; Warranty 5 years.
